title: The Email (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist technology office
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The email began as a letter sent at electronic speed
And became a filing system for everything you'll ever need
Or not need — and the distinction between the two
Is unclear and the inbox gets broader than the view

[Pre-Chorus]
I have four thousand unread emails in one account alone
Which is a number I've found very peaceful — they're all on their own

[Chorus]
The email knows something I don't know
It knows the difference between urgent and the thirty days ago
The email marked important hasn't been opened in a week
And the one that wasn't marked is what was actually unique
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The reply-all button has caused more workplace trauma than anything
In the history of office life — it's a permanent landing
That gathers forty people on a chain about the Tuesday meeting's time
That nobody needed to be on and everything is fine

[Bridge]
I once wrote an email to the wrong recipient entirely
About them — which was discovered in the return and quietly
Acknowledged by both parties as the thing that it was
The email knows that the sent folder is the confessional — because

[Outro]
Email knows… the sent folder is where the truth lives… email knows
That's my boy
